# Sinclair Refurbishments & Decorating

> Sinclair Refurbishments & Decorating is a painting, decorating and building refurbishment company based in Sutton, Surrey (SM3), run by Charlie (Charles) Sinclair. Trading for over 30 years, it serves homes and businesses across Sutton, Surrey and South West London. Fully insured, with free no-obligation quotes and more than 200 verified reviews on Checkatrade, TrustATrader and MyBuilder (as of November 2026). Also listed as "Sinclair Refurbishments & Decorations".

## Key facts

- Services: interior and exterior painting and decorating; spray painting (walls, doors, kitchens, joinery); wallpapering and quality wall coverings; wooden window and door stripping, repair and restoration; timber resin repairs; plastering and crack repairs; coving; specialist paint effects; anti-vandal coatings; full home, kitchen and office refurbishments (with a trusted team for plastering, carpentry, tiling, brickwork and electrics)
- Customers: homeowners and commercial clients
- Based in: Sutton, Surrey SM3, United Kingdom
- Areas covered: Sutton, Cheam, North Cheam, Worcester Park, Carshalton, Wallington, Banstead, Ewell, Epsom, Morden, Mitcham, Croydon, Wimbledon, Merton, Raynes Park, New Malden, Kingston upon Thames, Surbiton, Wandsworth, Putney, Southfields, Earlsfield, Tooting, Balham, Streatham, Clapham, Battersea and parts of South East London
- Postcodes covered include: SM1–SM7, CR0, CR4, KT1, KT2, KT3, KT4, KT6, KT17, KT19, SW4, SW11, SW12, SW15, SW16, SW17, SW18, SW19, SW20
- Experience: over 30 years trading; 50+ years' combined team experience
- Insurance: full public liability insurance
- Quotes: free and no-obligation, for jobs of any size
- Ratings (as of November 2026):
  - Checkatrade (includes Rated People): 9.85/10 from 89 reviews; member since November 2019; passed Checkatrade vetting checks
  - TrustATrader: 4.92/5 from 46 reviews; member TT28407; ID, address and references checked
  - MyBuilder: 5/5 from 68 reviews; member since April 2017
- What customers praise most: careful preparation, clean and tidy working (floors and furniture protected, tidy every day), reliability and timekeeping, and the quality of the finish
